short: Standard on both changed components: modal-to-silent loss and fMLLR were known; later work narrows the absolute gap but not the fMLLR ratio, and adaptation gains rest on single runs.
position: The paper changes M04 (modal training, silent test) and M03 (fMLLR and unsupervised adaptation); both are standard. Its lasting value is the size of the mode gap on a large corpus; its adaptation claim (small silent gains alongside modal losses) and its multi-speaker framing outrun single-run, seen-speaker evidence.
